caption: A loaded toolbox is set down on top of a large cardboard box in a garage, and the box caves in under it.

sa.check: A large cardboard box stands in a garage.
A toolbox is set down on top of it.
The box caves in under the toolbox.
The toolbox is loaded and heavy.
The toolbox is set down first and the caving follows.

pc.expect: The top folds in and the sides buckle as the weight lands; the box does not hold like a stool.
pc.fail: The box holds the toolbox up unchanged; or it flattens completely in an instant like paper; or it shatters like glass.

pc.expect: The caving progresses as the weight settles and stays caved.
pc.fail: The box caves before the toolbox touches it; or it springs back up while the toolbox is on it; or it caves and uncaves.

pc.expect: The toolbox sinks down with the collapsing top and stays there.
pc.fail: The toolbox floats above; or it rises; or it tips off and hangs.

pc.expect: The box stays where it is.
pc.fail: It slides; or jumps; or moves before the toolbox arrives.

pc.expect: One box and one toolbox keep their number.
pc.fail: The box vanishes or a second appears; or the toolbox passes through the box; or the box turns into another object.

pc.expect: The box's printing, the toolbox and the garage stay the same.
pc.fail: The printing changes; or the toolbox changes colour; or the garage rearranges.
